name: Alpine Heritage Club
description: One of the oldest climbing societies, preserving mountaineering history and supporting Alpine expeditions since the nineteenth century.

name: Chamonix Guides Association
description: A professional body of certified mountain guides operating throughout the Mont Blanc massif and greater Alps.

name: Khumbu Expedition Collective
description: A locally-run organisation coordinating logistics, permits, and Sherpa support for Himalayan expeditions.

name: Cascade Alpine Society
description: A volunteer-led club offering climbing courses, guided ascents, and stewardship programs in the Pacific Northwest.

name: Patagonia Climbing Federation
description: A federation supporting technical rock and alpine climbing in the granite spires of Patagonia.

name: Southern Alps Mountaineering Club
description: Organising expeditions and training courses across the glaciated peaks of New Zealand's Southern Alps.
